description: Marks the saved Discord bot connection inactive as the Discord card's Disconnect does: Sergio stops reading and posting there. Reconnect any time on the same card by pasting the bot token again. Nothing is sent to clients. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat is the same disconnect. An owner-level change: Sergio tells the owner after it is made.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

reason.description: Why you are doing this, in one sentence. The owner sees it in the notice Sergio sends after the change.

name: disconnect_discord
title: Disconnect Discord
